I'm trying to work out what the schematic shows. The VDD rail is at the top, and on the left there are two PMOS devices, M5a and M4a, with a latch involved. I'm still unsure whether M5a and M4a are in series or whether their gates tie to different nodes, so I'm reading the connections again.

Both latch-gated PMOS devices, M4a and M5a, look like they connect VDD to v_ON and to the node at the left, and I'm checking whether the other differential-pair side mirrors that. The cross-coupled PMOS and NMOS pairs also need their gates and drains matched against the netlist, and the latch nets should all turn out to be the same net.

I'm checking the merges in the netlist: net2, net5, and net10 are all latch nets and should become one. The input nets, net7 and net9, stay separate. I've also looked at the crossing v_ON and v_OP wires, and the cross-coupling and the unconnected J1 and J2 look fine to me.
